text:
Ravi: Weekend crew  who's up for bagels + office trivia this Sunday? thinking 10:30 meetup, bagels from "Crust & Crumb" then trivia in the lounge at 11. :bagel: :brain:
Nina: love it. can we do a vanpool from the west side? parking is tight.
Kai: I can drive 4 ppl, leaving 10:00 from my place.
Tess: count me in. any dietary stuff? I'm gluten-free.
Ravi: noted, will grab GF option for Tess. Victor, you bringing the trivia cards?
Victor: yup got a fresh set of pop-culture + random facts. 10 rounds, low stakes.
LogiBot: Poll created: "Going to bagel brunch + trivia?" Options: Yes, Maybe, No. Link: https://logibot.example/polls/ck3
Nina: Nina: if vanpool's happening, can someone pick me up near Elm & 5th?
Kai: I can swing by Elm & 5th. 4 seats including driver.
Tess: RSVP yes. prefer almond milk.
Ravi: budget ~ $15 each? covers bagel + coffee. trivia pot optional.
Victor: fine with $15. also quick ask: bring board games or just Hosted Trivia?
Nina: maybe one board game for people who skip trivia (Codenames?)
Ravi: good call. I'll pack Codenames.
LogiBot: Calendar invite created and shared: https://calendar.example/event/xyz789
Kai: leaving my building at 10:00 then lobby. I'll DM pick-up details.
Tess: thanks for sorting gf + almond milk, Ravi.
Ravi: no probs. see you Sunday! :sun_with_face:
